resources.string:
DroneLink Mobile is test software (beta).

• Fly only where drones are allowed, within sight, and follow your local rules (CASA in Australia, DGCA / Digital Sky in India).
• Your controller's Return-to-Home (RTH) and pause buttons always work, even if this app freezes.
• First test with the drone on the ground in Simulator mode (Settings), with the propellers removed.
• Keep DJI Fly installed as a backup.
This test build has no DJI App Key, so it can\'t connect to a drone. Add the key as the GitHub secret DJI_APP_KEY and build again.
